$comment: Single source of truth for app roles and permissions. Read by apps/api (skf_api.core.permissions) and apps/web (src/lib/permissions.ts). Change here only.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Platform owner. Manages users, compute targets and secrets.

ml_engineer.label: ML engineer
ml_engineer.description: Creates skills and presets, launches any run, evaluates checkpoints.

operator.label: Operator
operator.description: Launches runs from approved presets within a GPU-hour budget.

safety_reviewer.label: Safety reviewer
safety_reviewer.description: Reviews gate reports and approves or rejects releases.

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.description: Read-only access to dashboards, runs and reports.
